scope: Bilingual New Jersey seller-education articles reviewed against the last-three-month Search Console export. Distinct educational intent is retained; overlapping, stale, or zero-value routes are consolidated one hop. No source supports a promised price, timing, savings, audience profile, legal outcome, tax outcome, or market forecast.

gscEvidence.exportColumns: Last 3 months Clicks and Last 3 months Impressions
gscEvidence.normalization: Clean and .html variants were summed by language and path stem.

sources.publisher: New Jersey Department of Banking and Insurance
sources.title: Bulletin 24-11: Brokerage relationships, agreements, disclosures and compensation
sources.use: Supports current written brokerage-services-agreement, seller-disclosure, business-relationship, and negotiable-compensation context.
sources.limit: It does not set a commission, choose a representation model, interpret a contract, or predict a transaction result.

sources.title: Realty Transfer Fee
sources.use: Supports the current Realty Transfer Fee framework, seller responsibility, graduated percent fee, forms, and exemption resources.
sources.limit: It does not calculate a property-specific closing statement or determine whether a seller qualifies for any exemption.

sources.publisher: New Jersey Division of Consumer Affairs
sources.title: Seller's Property Condition Disclosure Statement
sources.use: Supports organizing known property condition, occupancy, system, environmental, and flood information for a residential sale.
sources.limit: The form is not a substitute for legal advice, inspections, repairs, or a property-specific review of disclosure duties.

sources.publisher: New Jersey Department of Environmental Protection
sources.title: Flood Risk Notification
sources.kind: state disclosure guidance and lookup tool
sources.use: Supports address-specific flood-risk research and the current seller and landlord flood-notification framework in New Jersey.
sources.limit: The screening resource does not replace a survey, insurance review, engineering opinion, or transaction-specific legal advice.

sources.title: Lead-Based Paint Disclosure Rule
sources.use: Supports the federal lead-information, records, pamphlet, warning-statement, and buyer-opportunity framework for most pre-1978 housing.
sources.limit: It does not determine whether a particular property is covered, exempt, lead-safe, or compliant without a fact-specific review.

sources.title: Publication 523: Selling Your Home
sources.use: Supports the tax-record and worksheet framework for basis, gain, main-home use, exclusions, business or rental use, and reporting questions.
sources.limit: It does not establish a seller's eligibility or taxable gain; those conclusions depend on records, facts, elections, and current tax advice.

sources.title: Publication 544: Sales and Other Dispositions of Assets
sources.use: Supports a records-first review when a property was used for business, rental, investment, or mixed personal and income-producing purposes.
sources.limit: It does not calculate basis, depreciation treatment, gain, loss, filing position, or the tax effect of a proposed sale.

sources.publisher: New Jersey Department of Community Affairs
sources.title: Landlord-Tenant Information
sources.use: Supports checking current landlord, tenant, lease, flood-notice, eviction, protected-tenancy, and Truth in Renting resources before a sale.
sources.limit: The hub is general information and does not decide lease rights, possession, notice, access, security-deposit, or closing questions.

sources.publisher: New Jersey Department of Community Affairs
sources.title: New Jersey Security Deposit Law
sources.use: Supports flagging security-deposit records, accrued interest, transfer, and tenant-notice questions when ownership of rental property changes.
sources.limit: It does not resolve disputed balances, lease interpretation, exemptions, closing instructions, or duties for a particular property.

sources.publisher: New Jersey Department of Community Affairs, Division of Fire Safety
sources.title: Fire Safety Service Portal: Smoke Certification Guide
sources.use: Supports checking the current smoke-alarm, carbon-monoxide-alarm, and portable-fire-extinguisher certificate process where applicable.
sources.limit: It does not replace the enforcing agency or municipality, which controls the application, inspection, timing, and property-specific requirements.

sources.title: Public State and County Housing Market Reports
sources.use: Supports using dated state and county reports as broad context while retaining the report period, property type, definitions, and publication lag.
sources.limit: A state or county report is not a valuation, a municipality report, a current comparable-sale analysis, or a forecast for one property.

sources.publisher: New Jersey Department of Environmental Protection
sources.title: County and Municipal Recycling Coordinator Locator
sources.use: Supports checking current county and municipal instructions before recycling, donating, or disposing of electronics and other controlled materials.
sources.limit: It does not establish what a particular program accepts, its hours, residency rules, fees, or safe handling instructions on a given date.
